categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in financial technology, providing comprehensive digital transformation solutions and customized software development and maintenance services for financial institutions. Its business segments include digital transformation innovation (consulting, products and solutions, cloud delivery and operations) and traditional financial IT services (software development, system integration, and technical maintenance).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include distributed platforms, microservices architecture, blockchain, digital currency, artificial intelligence, and Web 3.0. The company employs cloud-native architectures, modular application services, and blockchain-based financial infrastructure, with a strong focus on AI integration and compliance in financial scenarios.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are domestic and international central banks, large and medium-sized commercial banks, and financial regulatory institutions. Major clients include Bank of China, Bank of China Hong Kong, Hong Kong Monetary Authority, and other prominent banks in China, Hong Kong, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in Mainland China, Hong Kong, Thailand, and other international markets, with overseas business accounting for over 60% of revenue. It maintains subsidiaries and R&D centers in Shenzhen, Hong Kong, Beijing, Chengdu, and Thailand, emphasizing a dual domestic and international market strategy.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the financial technology supply chain, focusing on software development, system integration, and providing end-to-end digital transformation solutions and cloud operation services to financial institutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding overseas markets, advancing compliant Web 3.0 financial infrastructure, and deepening R&D in generative artificial intelligence for financial applications. The company emphasizes innovation in blockchain, digital currency, AI, and Web 3.0, aiming to enhance its financial microservices platform and develop new AI-driven financial products.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of software products, customized software development services, consulting, system integration, cloud operation and maintenance services, and licensing. The company uses contract-based billing, including milestone payments and service fees tied to project delivery and ongoing support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading financial technology comprehensive solution provider with over 20 years of experience, holding a strong competitive position in China and Hong Kong markets. It competes with other fintech firms specializing in banking digital transformation, blockchain, and AI-enabled financial services, leveraging its international presence and advanced technology capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 740 million, a 1.36% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 67.36 million, a 42.18% increase. The company maintains steady growth with a strong overseas revenue contribution exceeding 60%, and continues to invest significantly in R&D, with expenditures around RMB 70 million, representing about 9.5% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its integrated financial technology solutions that combine advanced AI, blockchain, and digital currency technologies tailored for banking digital transformation. It offers full lifecycle services from consulting to operation, backed by certified project management and a globalized, cross-cultural team. Its unique value lies in delivering secure, compliant, and innovative fintech infrastructure that supports clients’ digital and intelligent transformation needs.
